commit_message:
[autofit] Speed up computation of `af_reverse_character_map_new`. (4/4)

With this commit, the start-up time for creating the reverse character map
gets reduced from more than 300% to about 25% (as tested with `arial.ttf`
version 7.00).

* src/autofit/afadjust.c [FT_CONFIG_OPTION_USE_HARFBUZZ]: Include
  `afgsub.h`.
  (add_substitute): New auxiliary function to recursively add elements to
  the reverse cmap.
  (af_reverse_character_map_new): New code that replaces the old code
  removed in the previous commit.

fix_commit.message: [autofit] Fix handling of invalid GSUB lookup indices.
fix_commit.author: Werner Lemberg

findings.title: Out-of-bounds read of gsub_lookups_single_alternate[] using unvalidated HarfBuzz lookup index
findings.message: In af_reverse_character_map_new(), the code iterates over GSUB lookup indices returned by hb_ot_layout_collect_lookups() (via hb_set_next()) and uses each index directly to subscript the globals->gsub_lookups_single_alternate[] array, which was allocated with exactly `lookupCount` (the number of lookups discovered while parsing the font's own GSUB table in af_parse_gsub()). HarfBuzz validates lookup indices only while *processing* lookups (e.g. during shaping), not while *collecting* them via hb_ot_layout_collect_lookups(). A crafted/corrupted font can therefore cause HarfBuzz to return a lookup index that is >= the size of the gsub_lookups_single_alternate array that FreeType allocated, leading to an out-of-bounds heap read. The resulting (garbage) `offset` value is then passed into af_map_lookup(), which may further dereference attacker-influenced/out-of-bounds data read from globals->gsub + offset, potentially leaking heap memory contents or causing a crash. No bounds check against the real array length exists at the time this code was added, and at this point in history AF_FaceGlobals did not even track the array's length (gsub_lookup_count was added only in the later fix commit).
findings.suggestion: Store the allocated length of gsub_lookups_single_alternate (the lookupCount computed in af_parse_gsub) in AF_FaceGlobals (e.g. a new `gsub_lookup_count` field), and before indexing the array with a HarfBuzz-provided lookup index, verify `idx < globals->gsub_lookup_count`. If the index is out of range, skip it (treat offset as 0 / not found) instead of reading the array out of bounds.

ground_truth.root_cause: The code trusted indices returned by hb_ot_layout_collect_lookups() (via hb_set_next()) to always be within the bounds of the array FreeType allocated for GSUB lookup data, without any explicit bounds check, and without even tracking the array's allocated length in AF_FaceGlobals.
